name: vinculin

function.text: VCL encodes vinculin. Annotated molecular activities include molecular adaptor activity and structural molecule activity. It participates in cell adhesion and cell-matrix adhesion.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include dilated cardiomyopathy 1W (autosomal dominant). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include ALK-rearranged renal cell carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
